2571:20661.name: Table
2571:20661.description:
Description
A configurable data-table component with populated and empty states, up to ten columns and ten rows, optional row selection, and optional row numbering.


When to use
Use to present structured records that users need to scan and compare across consistent columns. Use the Empty state when no records are available.


Usage guidelines
Use clear column labels and keep cell content consistent by column.
Show only the columns required for the task.
Enable checkboxes only when bulk selection or row selection is supported.
Enable row numbers only when sequential references are useful.
Use the Empty state for true no-data outcomes and provide a relevant next action when possible.
For complex sorting, filtering, pagination, or responsive behavior, pair this component with the appropriate surrounding controls and patterns.


Properties
State — Switches between Default and Empty.
Show Column 1–10 — Shows or hides table columns.
Show Row 1–10 — Shows or hides data rows.
Show Checkbox — Shows or hides the selection column.
Show No — Shows or hides the row-number column.
Title — Sets the empty-state heading.
Body — Sets the empty-state supporting text.
CTA Label — Sets the empty-state action label.
Show Icon — Shows or hides the empty-state icon.
Show Title — Shows or hides the empty-state heading.
Show Description — Shows or hides the empty-state supporting text.
Show CTA — Shows or hides the empty-state action.
Icon — Swaps the empty-state icon.

2299:120.name: State=Default
2299:120.description:
Description
Displays the populated table with header and body rows.


When to use
Use when one or more records are available to display.


Usage guidelines
Keep header and body columns aligned.
Show only rows and columns required by the current dataset.
Use optional checkbox and number columns consistently.


Properties
Show Column 1–10 — Controls visible columns.
Show Row 1–10 — Controls visible rows.
Show Checkbox — Controls the selection column.
Show No — Controls the row-number column.

2308:991.name: Table Checkbox Header Cell
2308:991.description:
Description
A compact header cell containing the table's selection checkbox.


When to use
Use when the table supports selecting all visible or eligible rows.


Usage guidelines
Pair with Table Checkbox Body Cell in selectable rows.
Use an indeterminate state when only some eligible rows are selected.
Disable or omit it when bulk selection is unavailable.


Properties
Checkbox state — Configure the nested checkbox instance.

2187:18.name: State=off, Size=Small, Disabled=false
2187:18.description: Interactive, unselected checkbox in the Small size. Use when users can select an available independent option.

2308:987.name: Table No Header Cell
2308:987.description:
Description
A compact header cell for the row-number column.


When to use
Use above Table No Body Cell when the table displays numbered rows.


Usage guidelines
Keep the column narrow and aligned with row numbers.
Use consistently with the table's Show No option.


Properties
No exposed properties.

2308:996.name: Table Checkbox Body Cell
2308:996.description:
Description
A compact body cell containing a row-selection checkbox.


When to use
Use when users can select individual rows for bulk actions or comparison.


Usage guidelines
Place it consistently at the leading edge of each selectable row.
Keep selection state synchronized with the header checkbox.
Do not use it for an editable boolean data field.


Properties
Checkbox state — Configure the nested checkbox instance.

2308:989.name: Table No Body Cell
2308:989.description:
Description
A compact body cell that displays a row number.


When to use
Use when rows need a visible sequential reference independent of the record's data.


Usage guidelines
Keep numbering sequential after sorting, filtering, or pagination according to product requirements.
Align values consistently in the number column.
Use with Table No Header Cell.


Properties
No — Sets the displayed row number.

2299:100.name: Table Body Cell
2299:100.description:
Description
A reusable body cell container for table rows. It hosts a selectable Table Cell Value component so each column can display the appropriate content type while preserving consistent spacing and alignment.


When to use
Use inside Table Body Row when building data rows with text, badges, actions, status, product, or other supported cell content.


Usage guidelines
Keep one content type per cell.
Choose a cell-value variant that matches the data semantics.
Keep content concise; use truncation or a wider column for long values.
Maintain consistent alignment for cells in the same column.


Properties
Cell Value — Swaps the nested Table Cell Value component used by the cell.

2301:193.name: Type=Image Text
2301:193.description:
Description
Displays a thumbnail or avatar alongside a primary text value.


When to use
Use when a record benefits from visual identification, such as a person, product, or organization.


Usage guidelines
Use consistent image dimensions and crop behavior across the column.
Keep the text label short and meaningful.
Do not rely on the image alone to communicate identity.


Properties
Value — Sets the text displayed beside the image.
Image content — Override the nested image or avatar in the instance.

2301:203.name: Type=Badge
2301:203.description:
Description
Displays a compact badge for categorical or descriptive metadata.


When to use
Use for short categories, labels, tags, or non-interactive attributes.


Usage guidelines
Keep labels brief.
Use the same badge treatment for the same meaning across the table.
Do not use a badge as a button.


Properties
Value — Sets the badge label.

2841:130.name: Variant=primary
2841:130.description:
The default high-emphasis badge for general labels and key categories.


When to useUse when a label needs clear prominence but does not represent a success, warning, error, or informational state.


Usage guidelinesReserve for the most important neutral label in a group.
Prefer a semantic variant when the label communicates status.


PropertiesVariant: primary
Label: Editable badge text.

2574:767.name: Type=Number
2574:767.description:
Description
Displays a numeric value in a table cell.


When to use
Use for quantities, prices, percentages, counts, and other comparable numeric data.


Usage guidelines
Use consistent units, separators, and decimal precision within the column.
Align numbers consistently to support scanning and comparison.
Include currency or percentage symbols where needed.


Properties
Value — Sets the displayed number or formatted numeric string.

2301:198.name: Type=Action
2301:198.description:
Description
Displays a compact text action for a row-level task.


When to use
Use for one clear, high-priority action associated with the row.


Usage guidelines
Use a short verb-led label.
Avoid placing multiple competing primary actions in the same cell.
Use Action (Icon) when several compact actions are required.


Properties
Value — Sets the action label.

2266:1143.name: Roundness=Default, Style=Primary, Size=Small, State=Default
2266:1143.description:
This variant is a high-emphasis filled button for the most important action in a view, sized for dense layouts, toolbars, tables, or inline actions, uses the standard corner treatment, and represents the resting, interactive state.

WHEN TO USE
• Use for the main call to action or the preferred next step.
• Use when space is limited while maintaining a usable target.
• Use for the default product interface treatment.
• Use when the button is available and ready for interaction.

USAGE GUIDELINES
• Limit Primary buttons to one per section or decision point.
• Do not use Small merely to fit an overly long label.
• Keep the same corner treatment across buttons in one action group.
• Use Default as the resting representation in layouts and documentation.
• Use a concise, action-oriented label and include icons only when they improve comprehension.

PROPERTIES
• Style — Primary
• Size — Small
• Roundness — Default
• State — Default
• Label — Editable button text.
• Show Label — Toggles the text label.
• Show left icon / Show right icon — Toggles leading and trailing icons.
• Left icon / Right icon — Swaps the corresponding icon.

2301:191.name: Type=Text
2301:191.description:
Description
Displays a single plain-text value.


When to use
Use for names, dates, identifiers, categories, and other short values that need no additional visual treatment.


Usage guidelines
Keep values concise and use consistent formatting within the column.
Align numeric content according to the table's numeric-column convention.


Properties
Value — Sets the displayed text.

3344:394.name: State=Filled
3344:394.description:
The resting state of the dropdown after a value or valid selection has been provided.

WHEN TO USE
Use when the dropdown contains accepted content and is no longer focused.

USAGE GUIDELINES
Display the value or selected file clearly, keep relevant management actions available, and preserve supporting status information.

3166:123.name: Pagination
3166:123.description:
Description
Pagination lets users navigate through content or data that is divided across multiple pages. This component includes Previous and Next controls, individual page numbers, and an ellipsis for skipped page ranges.

Variant
Default — Use the standard pagination layout when users need sequential navigation and direct access to nearby pages.

When to use
• Use for long lists, tables, search results, or collections that are split into pages.
• Use when users need to understand their current position and move to a specific page.
• Avoid pagination when all content can be displayed clearly on one page or when continuous loading is more appropriate.

Usage guidelines
• Place pagination directly below the content it controls.
• Clearly distinguish the current page from available pages.
• Disable Previous on the first page and Next on the last page.
• Use an ellipsis to compress long page ranges while keeping the first, last, current, and nearby pages accessible.
• Preserve sorting, filters, and item order when users move between pages.
• Provide accessible labels for navigation controls and indicate the current page to assistive technologies.

Properties
• No configurable component properties are currently exposed.
• The current page numbers and Previous/Next labels are defined by the component’s internal layers.

2572:878.name: State=Empty
2572:878.description:
Description
Displays an empty-state message in place of table data.


When to use
Use when no records exist, filters return no results, or the user has not added data yet.


Usage guidelines
Explain why the table is empty in concise, actionable language.
Tailor the title, description, and CTA to the actual empty-state cause.
Hide optional elements that do not add value.
Do not use this state for loading or error feedback.


Properties
Title — Sets the heading.
Body — Sets the supporting message.
CTA Label — Sets the action label.
Show Icon, Show Title, Show Description, Show CTA — Controls optional content visibility.
Icon — Swaps the empty-state icon.

2266:703.name: Roundness=Default, Style=Secondary, Size=Regular, State=Default
2266:703.description:
This variant is a medium-emphasis filled button for an action that supports the primary action, sized for most standard interface contexts, uses the standard corner treatment, and represents the resting, interactive state.

WHEN TO USE
• Use for alternate actions that should remain visible without competing with Primary.
• Use as the default size in forms, dialogs, and general page actions.
• Use for the default product interface treatment.
• Use when the button is available and ready for interaction.

USAGE GUIDELINES
• Pair with Primary when users need a clear secondary choice.
• Prefer Regular when no special density or prominence requirement applies.
• Keep the same corner treatment across buttons in one action group.
• Use Default as the resting representation in layouts and documentation.
• Use a concise, action-oriented label and include icons only when they improve comprehension.

PROPERTIES
• Style — Secondary
• Size — Regular
• Roundness — Default
• State — Default
• Label — Editable button text.
• Show Label — Toggles the text label.
• Show left icon / Show right icon — Toggles leading and trailing icons.
• Left icon / Right icon — Swaps the corresponding icon.
